nodes.label: Vendi Score Metric
nodes.rationale: Novel diversity evaluation metric based on Shannon entropy of eigenvalues of similarity matrix; connects ecology and quantum statistical mechanics to ML

nodes.label: Effective Rank
nodes.rationale: Mathematical foundation for Vendi Score; exponential of entropy of normalized singular values; used in signal processing and ML

nodes.label: Von Neumann Entropy
nodes.rationale: Connection to quantum statistical mechanics; Vendi Score equals exponential of von Neumann entropy of normalized similarity matrix

nodes.label: IntDiv (Internal Diversity) Metric
nodes.rationale: Baseline diversity metric based on average pairwise dissimilarity; used in molecular generative modeling; has limitations in capturing feature correlations

nodes.label: Molecular Generative Model Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Application domain where Vendi Score identifies model weaknesses (e.g., HMM duplicates) not detected by IntDiv

nodes.label: Mode Collapse in GANs
nodes.rationale: Vendi Score captures fine-grained diversity distinctions beyond Number of Modes metric; reveals imbalances in mode distribution

nodes.label: Image Generative Model Diversity
nodes.rationale: Vendi Score applied to CIFAR-10, ImageNet, LSUN datasets; complements existing metrics like FID and Precision/Recall

nodes.label: Text Decoding Algorithm Diversity
nodes.rationale: Vendi Score applied to image captioning with diverse beam search; correlates with n-gram diversity but captures additional aspects

nodes.label: Determinantal Point Processes (DPPs)
nodes.rationale: Related mathematical framework for diverse subset selection; uses determinant of kernel matrix; less straightforward interpretation than Vendi Score

nodes.label: Spectral Clustering
nodes.rationale: Related use of eigenvalues of similarity matrix; Vendi Score more general than counting connected components
